truths.truth: `deferred` is a real gate value: the schema, the route table and the resolver all admit it, an unknown gate is refused naming five, and self-verify reports no vocabulary drift
truths.evidence: cadence-core/config.schema.json:77,80,83,87 (all four `review.triggers.<t>.gate` values arrays), cadence-core/route-table.json:19 `["off","advisory","deferred","blocking","adjudicated"]`, cadence-core/bin/route.mjs:126 DEFAULT_GATES same five same order. truths.truth: `deferral` is a fire receipt `risk-check status` joins on, so a deferred fire clears the range instead of leaving it unfired forever
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:4169 FIRE_RECEIPTS now five names, with the block comment at 4140-4167 rewritten to name what produces the fifth. Live, both polarities in two scratch repos: with a `destructive` match recorded by `risk-check run` and NO receipt, `risk-check status` answered {ok:false, reason:"risk-fire-missing", state:"unfired"}; after `trace append --family outcome --event deferral --trigger risk_surface --plan 1 --base <b> --sha <h>` returned ok:true, the same call on the same range answered {ok:true, state:"recorded"}. Test pin: planning.test.mjs 'risk-check status: a `deferral` receipt settles the range it names' and 'the acceptance is FIRE_RECEIPTS membership, not any outcome event', both green.

truths.truth: A deferred fire leaves the queue member beside the REVIEW file and writes no adjudication record - a record at fire time is impossible by construction, not by convention
truths.evidence: Live `planning.mjs deferred record --phase 7 --trigger diff --discriminator plan-1 --base <b> --head <h> --payload <findings>` wrote only .planning/phases/7/DEFERRED-diff-plan-1.json, findings stored verbatim, resolved base_id/head_id not the caller's spelling; no ADJUDICATION-* appeared. Second identical call refused with reason:"record-exists". The construction half probed directly against cadence-core/bin/lib/adjudication-record.mjs buildEntries: a ruling of `undefined` and a ruling of `unadjudicated` are both refused with 'ruling must be one of survived | downgraded | refuted', and RULINGS is frozen at three. The advisory-arm shape the deferred arm reuses is the raw {"findings": []} object - .planning/phases/2/REVIEW-risk_surface-plan-1.md holds exactly that, and cadence-core/references/triage-gate.md:19 passes that same file as --payload.

truths.truth: `deferred list` is ONE derivation over both homes: supersession by the sibling record only, an unreadable path refused rather than counted as empty
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:5292 QUEUE_HOMES=['phases','deferred'], readQueue at 5300-5400. truths.truth: The queue survives the milestone prune and a carried member stays both adjudicable and re-armable from its new home

truths.truth: Neither forbidden rail moved: no gate value reaches git-guard.mjs, no stakes cell fires `deferred`, and the one-round re-arm cap gained a queue-keyed reading without disturbing the corr-keyed one

Enforcement is prose-plus-artifact rather than a code branch, which is the same disposition the pre-existing corr-keyed cap already has - no .mjs in this tree branches on any gate value (grep for quoted 'blocking' across cadence-core/bin returns only route.mjs's DEFAULT_GATES). human_checks.name: Run a live /cad-execute chain under bypass permissions on a tree with review.triggers.<t>.gate=deferred set and a fire that raises a blocker
human_checks.expected: The gate fires, the reviewer runs, a REVIEW-<trigger>-<discriminator>.md and a DEFERRED-<trigger>-<discriminator>.json land in .planning/phases/<N>/, a `deferral` receipt is appended, the run CONTINUES to `executed` with nothing prompting for input, and the phase's commits sit on the integration branch.
human_checks.why_human: Out of reach, not merely unexercised: /cad-execute's body is a skill and no agent (including this verifier) can invoke a slash command, and the fire-site hop into triage-gate.md's `deferred` arm is agent-executed prose with no code branch to probe. It also needs the host's bypass-permissions mode, which is a property of the operator's session rather than of this repository.

human_checks.name: Run a live /cad-land against a tree with an unadjudicated DEFERRED-*.json and git.auto_close false
human_checks.expected: The land refuses at the top of step 3 before any publish ask, naming each queued finding by trigger and discriminator with its count, and pointing at references/triage-gate.md; nothing is pushed, merged or tagged.
human_checks.why_human: Out of reach and irreversible on the other branch: /cad-land is a skill this verifier cannot invoke, and the arm that would run if it did NOT refuse publishes to a remote. The refusal's siting and its test pin are already verified statically (truth 8); what a live run adds is whether the reading agent obeys it.
